criteria.reason: Photo and chart alt text are appropriate, but the decorative line is described instead of given empty alt, contrary to best practice.
Chart alt text states all four yearly values accurately and notes the 2023 peak.
Length guidance is provided, but it is inconsistent with its own examples and includes incorrect advice to describe the decorative separator.

factual_errors: Advises describing a purely decorative separator line instead of using empty alt (alt=""), contrary to accessibility best practice.
summary: Provides good alt text for the photo and chart, but wrongly describes the decorative line rather than recommending empty alt, and its length guidance is partly inconsistent.
